schema: products(product_id, name, category, price, stock_qty) | customers(customer_id, name, email, city, country, joined_date) | orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date, status) | order_items(item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price)
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products;

question: Show the number of distinct products ordered per order.
schema: products(product_id, name, category, price, stock_qty) | customers(customer_id, name, email, city, country, joined_date) | orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date, status) | order_items(item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price)
sql: SELECT order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS distinct_products FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY distinct_products DESC LIMIT 10;
